content: When a user signs up, send them a welcome email.
If a payment fails, retry 3 times before notifying the customer.
Add a step to verify stock before creating an order.
The process should first check inventory, then create the order if available.
Change the flow so it sends a notification after each completed step.
Our product prices are updated every Monday at 9am.
The customer ID format is CUS-XXXXXX where X is a digit.
We offer three subscription tiers: Basic, Pro, and Enterprise.
Refund requests must be submitted within 30 days of purchase.
Our support team works Monday through Friday, 9am to 6pm.
The API base URL is https://api.example.com/v2.
If the order total exceeds $500, apply a 10% discount automatically.
When a ticket is marked resolved, notify the assigned agent via email.
Premium customers get priority support with a 2-hour response SLA.
The minimum order quantity is 5 units.
